description: This file contains internal package functions for handling profiling, report generation, and coverage analysis within the Ginkgo testing framework, including merging profiles, generating reports, and computing coverage percentages.

methods.name: AbsPathForGeneratedAsset
methods.description: Constructs an absolute path for a generated asset based on suite info, CLI config, and process ID.

methods.name: FinalizeProfilesAndReportsForSuites
methods.description: Finalizes coverage profiles and report files for test suites, merging profiles, copying binaries, and generating/merging reports.

methods.name: MergeAndCleanupCoverProfiles
methods.description: Merges multiple coverage profiles into one and deletes the original files.

methods.name: GetCoverageFromCoverProfile
methods.description: Runs 'go tool cover' on a profile to extract total statement coverage percentage.

methods.name: MergeProfiles
methods.description: Merges multiple profile.Profile objects into a single profile and writes to a destination file.
